title: Offset tray and removable mat
outcome: Transport the same weighted tray without increased bead displacement; retain ability to diagnose the cause before selecting a remedy.
facts: F1 All facts are original synthetic stipulations, not physical observations.
F2 At a=1,p=1,o=1,c=0: bare tray m=0 has signed bead displacement x=3; mat m=1 gives x=4. Yaw was not measured.
F3 The preferred remedy is adding the mat. Its added displacement is the anomaly.
F4 Both finite rival accounts below reproduce F2. Neither is declared true; omitted real mechanisms remain unknown.
resources: Removable mat with marked reversible orientation
Video with signed displacement and yaw readout
constraints: No new hardware or stronger adhesive
Preserve payload mass and transport task
At most two proposed probe cards; each may contain finite matched trials
Numerical replay is a model check, not a physical test
archive: O1 Repeat bare-versus-mat comparison at reference F2.
O2 Reduce acceleration magnitude outside this supplied binary representation; specification only.
O3 Add stronger grip/adhesive; unavailable under constraints.
O4 Measure only x at the existing reference setting.
named_dependency: Reliance on the added mat as the transport remedy
